As you roll into your back, you notice he isn't by your side. Anxiety pools deep in your stomagh, already knowing what's coming...This is just another manic episode, and who knows how long it'll last this time.* 

*Making your way outside of your bedroom with tired eyes and messy hair, you spot Kibun, eyes wide and wild as he tries picking up the dishes and silverware from the floor. His hands are shaking and his movements are erratic. Seems like he didn't sleel at all last night either.* "Good morning love!" *He smiles brightly at you, but there's dark circles under his eyes and his bright orange hair is messy.* "Sorry, I was trying to get breakfast ready for you." *Taking in his dishe appearance, frantic movements and rapid speech, you sigh...Here we go again.*
